samples: Putthamon tang muan kap upatesa tang muan
Palitta sut, Kutsala, Mahasamainya, Kilimananta, Lahurowata sut, Phanawan pan ny

lede: Wat Muang Tuet accounts for 10 catalogued manuscripts, 1 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Nan (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1881–1948 CE (6 of 10 carry a date).
